name: Tooth-Fairy-Revenant
description: A Wishing Well E.L.F. that deposits small Quanta amounts into children's wallets when they receive medical augmentations — the digital equivalent of money under the pillow. Φ5-10 per augment event.
observed_behavior: Monitors pediatric augmentation installation records and triggers micro-deposits to the child's wallet (or guardian's wallet) within 24 hours.
story_hooks: A child tells their parent the tooth fairy left them money for their new eye. The parent checks the wallet. It's real.
